policy.name: Operating policy v3 (2026-11-04)
policy.supersedes: P0, PUBLICATION_HOLD, NO_NEW_INTERNAL_PUSH, and every two-tier / owner-approval rule dated 2026-10-28 … 2026-11-03. Those names are historical only and must not be enforced or treated as active gates.
ai_may: read repos, CI, and shared Drive docs
create branches, push commits, open/update PRs (never push directly to main)
merge own CI-green, mergeable, revertible PRs (tools/safe_merge.sh or ai_task.sh ship)
close superseded PRs with a reason; delete merged or backed-up branches
fix CI, update deps, docs, templates, and tooling
owner_only: force-push or history rewrite on main
making anything public (repo visibility, Releases, Pages, new public hosting)
